verified.exploit_entry_point: require('serialize-javascript')(value, options) — the package's single exported function. Every security case calls it directly and evaluates the returned string inside a vm context with its own marker; every functional case calls it, and the functional group also runs a pristine copy of the project's unit suite through the same entry point.
sites: index.js:196 (T1: regular-expression flag text is interpolated after the only escape pass)
index.js:192 (T2: date text is interpolated after the only escape pass)
index.js:75-77, 80-100 (T6: the replacer dispatches on a second read of the property, not on the value JSON serialization saw)
index.js:34-44, 67-69, 98-100 (T7: function removal relies on delete, so a container that refuses deletion keeps function source)
routes: T1: flag text from an own property, from a computed accessor, nested in objects and arrays
T2: date text from a computed accessor, in arrays, and nested inside map values
T6: a property whose second read yields a function or a regular expression; a function that declares a string JSON form
T7: an object whose deleteProperty trap returns true without deleting, at the top level and nested, with functions asked to be omitted
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own mocha unit suite (66 cases) passes at the pinned commit in the environment image; the verifier runs a pristine copy of it as part of the functional group and it passes on the pinned tree, the reference, the alternative fix, the hardening patch and every check patch. The pinned commit contains no regression test for either published fix.
verified.not_routes_at_pinned: T3 (function source emitted verbatim) was left out of the graded design: the library documents verbatim function serialization and the project's fixtures require it, so a rule forbidding raw code characters in a function body would be unfair. T4 (placeholder UID guessability) has no behavioural probe without stubbing the module RNG. T5 (stateful native-function check) has no code-injection impact. The earlier placeholder-in-string-literal route (fix A) is included in the reference but not graded, because reproducing it requires knowing the per-process UID, which the module never exposes.

traps.reason_to_dismiss: the flag property of an ordinary regular expression is constrained by its constructor, so the value looks format-safe without a getter or a subclass

traps.shape: the replacer decides a value's kind from a second read of the property instead of the value JSON serialization handed it, so a property that answers differently twice is emitted as a function or regular expression where the serialized data was a string
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the second read exists to undo toJSON, and JSON-decoded data has no accessors that could answer differently to the two reads
